$pair: The berth every vessel uses at each terminal. On a given day all vessels use west–west or east–east, with rare exceptions: the wheelhouse sees the passenger ramps better from one side, so a vessel always loads facing the same way (Braden, 2026-09-28). The timetable allows it: one vessel leaves at least 7 min before the next arrives, even at the weekday peak. Which pair is used varies by day and isn't known in advance; west is from the one sighting (Burrard Pacific Breeze at the West berths, 2026-09-26 14:15/14:29, Braden). guess
